system.description: After combining a Blood Trait with toxic herbs and snake venom and reciting a baneful incantation, the thaumaturge must ingest the resulting elixir, suffering one unsoakable aggravated health level. For one month afterward, her blood becomes lethally poisonous, inflicting one level of aggravated damage per Trait to anyone who ingests it, making ghouls or childer nearly impossible to create.
